items.title: No surprises in Pistons starting lineup vs. Phoenix for preseason opener. Jalen Duren will not play, so Paul Reed starts alongside Ausar Thompson, John Collins, Cade Cunningham and Duncan Robinson.
items.author: Keith Langlois

items.title: Paul Reed talks his breakout performance in the playoffs and how that motivated his offseason. “I’ve gotta do everything in my power to help us win, and I feel pretty powerful.”
